summary: RedHill Biopharma filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to increase the maximum aggregate offering amount under its existing at-the-market Sales Agreement with H.C. Wainwright, permitting up to $2,587,409 of additional American Depositary Shares, each representing 10,000 ordinary shares, to be sold from time to time. Prior sales totaled $49,690.55. The supplement reflects the Form F-3 General Instruction I.B.5 one-third public float cap, with the ADS closing at $0.539 on October 9, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
